display.title: Kislev, Month of Miracles: Unity Through a Letter in the Sefer Torah
display.summary_short: Kislev is a month of miracles. As Chanukah approaches, Uncle Yossi calls on children to unite by buying a letter in the new children's Sefer Torah and sharing the mitzvah.
display.summary_long: A pre-Chanukah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, aired in Kislev 5750. Uncle Yossi recalls the Rebbe's blessing that 5750 be 'a year of miracles', especially in Kislev, the month of the Chanukah miracle, when one day's oil burned for eight. In Al HaNissim we ask Hashem to do wonders 'in those days, at this time'. In the Chanukah story the Jewish people were saved in the merit of unity, and the strongest power to unite us is the Torah. That is why the Rebbe urges every child to have a letter written in the new children's Sefer Torah: just write to Tzivos Hashem. Like Avraham and Sarah, people of chesed, children should share this mitzvah with relatives, friends and classmates, so that we become one nation with one Torah from the One Creator. Like the menorah's candles burning together, we unite to spread the light of Torah and mitzvos.
display.lesson: The Torah unites us: get a letter in the children's Sefer Torah and help others get one too.
